context_requirements: NOD1 protein expression in the cell line
Presence of NOD1 ligand (iE-DAP or other peptidoglycan fragments) or constitutive NOD1 signaling
Intact NF-kB / MAPK signaling downstream of NOD1
Myeloid or epithelial lineage with functional innate immune signaling
falsifiers: Reproducible induction of NF-kB target genes (e.g., NFKBIA, CXCL2, IL1B, TICAM1) at 6 h in any line
Reproducible repression of NOD1-dependent inflammatory genes at 6 h or 24 h
Dose-dependent transcriptional changes shared across multiple lines at 10 micromolar
Changes in interferon or oxidative stress programs attributable to NOD1 inhibition

evidence.supports: NOD1 is expressed and functional in human mesenchymal stem cells, where NOD1 agonism enhances proliferation and invasion and modulates IL-8, indicating NOD1 can drive transcriptional programs in responsive cell types.
NOD1 activation by iE-DAP induces inflammatory and oxidative stress responses in bovine mammary epithelial cells, showing NOD1 signaling is coupled to NF-kB and stress gene transcription.
